entries.title: The Great Migration 2
entries.description: Moved the game off of Render.com onto an Amazon server - we got six months of Roam, people!

entries.title: (Hopefully) Less Loading Time
entries.description: Made it so that sprites are optimized and cached for 30 days - hopefully that should not only lessen load time, it should also free a lot of Bandwidth - that stuff's valuable!

entries.title: Zen Garden Fix no.3
entries.description: Fixed the Zen Garden once more! Coin collection should work guarenteed. Now, for the usual- ahem .. obtain sprouts by buying them or from killing zombies! Grow your sprouts to earn coins, and play as special plants!

entries.title: Plant Fixes
entries.description: Fixed Hypnoflower's attacks and Gloom-Shroom's attacks, both should now work properly as intended!

entries.title: Little Zombies Back In Action
entries.description: Flag 25's minigame should properly make zombies small again. Hopefully.

entries.title: Join the Discord!
entries.description: Join our discord server! We need new faces.
